tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per bid document
Tender inviting Authority had right to reject or accept the tender at any time before awarding the contract
Any changes in the tender can be done kpp portal by performing corrigendum or addendum only will not publish in the news paper

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Out of 5 years minimum three year Experience in Supply, Installation and Maintenance of Traffic enforcement cameras ITMS Surveillance Cameras with Satisfactory Completion Certificate issued in the name of the Tenderer Should worked on ITMS Analytics Like ANPR, Wrong way, without helmet, not wearing seat belt

The Tenderer should have executed in 3 years at least one work for setting up of command control room and video wall as one of the main components. Tenderer should have executed and presently running traffic enforcement software.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copies of the work done certificate. Satisfactory completion certificate with clear mention of the value, description of services.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have executed Establishment of Integrated Traffic Management System (ITMS) and solutions including Design, Supply, Installation, Testing/Training and Commissioning, work during last 3 years till date 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 for any of the Government Department/ Government Undertaking/ Government Organization in India for not less than 80% of the estimated bid value i.e. 80.00 lakhs for single order.For micro and small enterprises Establishment of Integrated Traffic Management System (ITMS) and solutions including Design, Supply, Installation, Testing/Training and Commissioning, work during last 3 years till date 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 for any of the Government Department/ Government Undertaking/ Government Organization in India for not less than 40 % of the estimated bid value i.e. 40.00 lakhs single order in the year and same unit.
The Tenderer /company/ Agency/contractor/firm should be registered under companies act/ /MSME/UDYAM registration.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid registration certificate should be attached.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer or OEM must possess valid ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001:2013, ISO 14001 :2015 from ISO institute
The Tenderer/OEM must possess a valid CMMI Level 5 certification from a recognized CMMI institute.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid Certification from CMMI institute

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the Tenderer is not OEM, The Tenderer may collaborate with an OEM for any product or solution supplied as part of this project (meeting specifications outlined in the section scope of work of the RFP). Hence the Tenderer must provide mandatorily a MAF certification from the OEM for the work of Establishment of Integrated Traffic Management System and solutions including Design, Supply, Installation, Testing/Training and Commissioning which comprises of the feature specifications as outlined in the scope of work.1.Manufacturers Authorization Form as per Annexure D: Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) 2.BIS ER/STQC certificate issued by competent authority for offered make/models of ANPR Cameras or other relevant cameras. 3.The Tenderer/OEM must possess a valid ISO 42001:2023 for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) certification issued by reputed ISO institutions.4.The Tenderer/OEM must possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 5. The Tenderer/OEM must possess a valid CMMi Level 5 certification from a recognized CMMi institute.6. The Tenderer/OEM must possess a valid ISO/IEC 27001:2013 or latest 7.Declaration from the ANPR Camera OEM stating that the MAC (Media Access Control) address of the proposed ANPR camera is registered in the name of the OEM supplying the cameras.8. CCTV OEM should be full member of ONVIF and support S,G,T,M profile for seamless integration with existing VMS and AI software and same will cross check online in ONVIF website. OEM should give the declaration about full membership at the time of bidding.9.A copy of the Product brochure for each Product/hardware/software to be provided.10.Detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the product/hardware/software being offered should be OEM approved.11.FCC/UL/ROHS Certification for offered make/module of cameras.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Documents required as per RFP document Clause No.2.15.8

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the Tenderer itself is the OEM, then the requirement to provide an MAF certification is waived. In such cases, the Tenderer must provide a self-declaration on company letterhead accompanying their status as the OEM and its commitment to fulfilling the project requirements specified in the tender. 1. Copy of Certificate of Incorporation signed by Authorized Signatory of the Tenderer 2.BIS certificate issued by competent authority for offered make/models of ANPR Cameras or other relevant cameras. 3. STQC / BIS-ER certificate issued by Standardisation Testing and Quality Certification Directorate, an attached office of Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India.(Submission of a valid STQC Certificate at the time of supply is mandatory) 4.ISO 42001 for stablishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS) certification issued by reputed ISO institutions.5.The OEM must possess a valid ISO 9001:2008 6.The OEM must possess a valid CMMi Level 5 certification from a recognized CMMi institute.7. The OEM must possess a valid ISO/IEC 27001-2013 or latest 8.Declaration from the ANPR Camera OEM stating that the MAC (Media Access Control) address of the proposed ANPR camera is registered in the name of the OEM supplying the cameras.9. CCTV OEM should be full member of ONVIF and support S,G,T, M profile for seamless integration with existing VMS and AI software and same will cross check online in ONVIF website. OEM should give the declaration about full membership at the time of bidding. 10. A copy of the Product brochure for each product/hardware/software to be provided. 11.Detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the Product/hardware/software being offered.12.A copy of the Product brochure for each Product/hardware/software to be provided

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Documents required as per RFP document Clause No.2.15.9

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Field Survey Report and Product Demonstration. a)The Tenderer shall mandatorily visit the project site and submit a Site Survey Certificate confirming their understanding of the project scope and site conditions. The Site Survey Certificate shall be self attested by Tenderer, the report shall be submitted to tender inviting authority and must be uploaded in tender document eligibility criteria.b)As part of technical evaluation, the Tenderer shall demonstrate the offered products, features and functionality, during the technical proposal stage as required by the Tender Inviting Authority, on no cost, no commitment basis to confirm meeting the tender specifications, field performance, features and functionalities as per the technical literature submitted by the Tenderer along with the Bid documents.c)The Tenderer will be intimated to arrange for demonstration of the product in front of technical committee at a specified location of Vijayapura immediately after opening of the technical bids, and to arrange the demo within 3 days from the date of invitation. If fails to give demonstration will be rejected.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Documents required as per RFP document clause no: 2.15.10

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The successful Tenderer/OEM should have or established fully functional Service/Support centre in Muddebihal or vijayapura city only.

Every Tenderer shall swear and upload an Affidavit accepting the above conditions and also stating that he / she has not been blacklisted by any Government Department / Autonomous Body / Corporation / Company / Local Body and that he / she is not involved in any litigation against any Government Department / Autonomous Body / Corporation / Company / Local Body.
The Tenderer should have valid PAN card/ permanent address proof/ GST registration copy.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- PAN and GST registration copy

(The Government Order No. FD 908 Exp-12/2019 Bengaluru Dated: 21-07-2020).
